pattern.short_summary: Two or more instances of the same kind of artifact are displayed simultaneously in parallel regions so that their differences can be read off directly.
pattern.definition: Two or more instances of the same kind of artifact are displayed simultaneously in parallel regions so that their differences can be read off directly. The layout is the mechanism: nothing is computed for the user beyond alignment and co-presence. Which instances occupy the slots may itself be user-selectable.
pattern.structural_signature: Two or more renderings of comparable objects occupy spatially parallel regions at the same time, with corresponding parts aligned across regions. The comparison quantity is the visual difference between regions, and the display may add a diff encoding over the alignment. Slot assignment is a user action ("select any two…") or a fixed before/after pairing.

dimension.category_description: How multiple possibilities are presented, previewed, maintained, blended, or compared before commitment.
dimension.classification_boundary: Requires a visible choice or comparison mechanism, not backend candidate-set processing alone.
